name: Proving Grounds 27: The Ashen Throne. The final boss arena: a fortress throne hall at dusk, sealed on every side. In under the south gate (it drops shut), across a walled court, through the great door into a pillared hall with raised aisles and tombs, up the stair doors into the throne room, its side chapels walled off, and the dais where the boss waits.
